primary_mismatch: The article page is still too display-led: the large media block and full-width author slab delay the actual reading surface and make the blog feel heavier than the restrained product system.

header_assessment.reason: The top chrome is thin and quiet with a compact brand mark, simple navigation, and one primary action.

module_system_assessment.reason: The author metadata is boxed as a heavy full-width panel and the cover image behaves like a dominant hero slab rather than a restrained editorial module.

first_glance_hierarchy_assessment.reason: The title is clear, but the first viewport gives too much space to metadata and media before the article body appears.

product_mode_assessment.reason: It remains a blog article, not a workspace app, and uses the dark restrained token system.

findings.recommendation: Convert it to a compact inline metadata row under the title.

target.targetHint: Full-width author/date panel below article title

findings.issue: Cover image dominates the first viewport.
findings.recommendation: Cap the cover height and crop it as a restrained article visual.

target.targetHint: Large cover image after metadata row

strengths: Dark semantic surfaces and restrained chrome are much closer to the handoff.
The page remains clearly a blog article and does not copy the workspace shell literally.
summary: The visual theme is close, but the article opening needs to become more reading-led and less hero/media-heavy.
